summary: Rebuilt agent-ctx's repo map as a ranked orientation layer: git ls-files for visibility (fixes negation/path/glob ignore bugs), import-graph in-degree + churn + entry-point ranking, real signatures and line numbers via ast.unparse, module docstrings, shebang sniffing for extensionless scripts, character budget replacing the silent 150-file cap, and a working-state block (branch/uncommitted/recent commits) in dump. get_git_branch no longer fabricates 'main'. summary: Validated the ranked map against titirek (162-file Next.js app) and fixed what only a real repo exposed: tsconfig/jsconfig path-alias resolution (401 alias vs 26 relative imports there; graph went from ~26 to 464 edges), file-system route entry points instead of mislabelled index.ts barrels, export default/export const symbol capture, deduped+dir-qualified importer labels, in-degree>=2 files shown even without symbols, and a single priority-ordered dump budget (memory > decisions > map) with the collapsed tail reserved. Corrected a memory.md claim that titirek falsified.
author: devhax

summary: Measured budget cost/return (tokens not time; saturation is O(repo size): titirek 27.6k chars vs 4.3MB/1.09M tokens uncapped on a 12k-file repo). Added --budget default/large/immense + AGENT_CTX_BUDGET to map and dump with thirds allocation. Replaced positional clipping with structural trimming: all ADR titles always shown with bodies expanded newest-first; memory trimmed by section priority with the top section truncated rather than dropped. Deleted clip_lines.
author: devhax

summary: map is now complete by default (measured ~40 tokens/file on real repos; titirek 10.9k->30.4k chars) while dump stays budgeted since it spends context. Added 'unlimited' preset. Made _split_sections HTML-comment aware and moved the record-format example into a comment in both templates and .agents/decisions.md, removing the phantom ADR from every dump.

summary: dump's Recent Activity tail was unbounded (5 entries, full summary+file list) and could burn thousands of chars, starving the map's leftover budget on verbose repos (titirek: map got only 5/232 files detailed). Added DUMP_ACTIVITY_BUDGET (1200 chars), per-entry summary/file-list eliding, and most-recent-first trimming with an announced count; verified on titirek the map recovered to 13/232 files. Added self-check _test_activity_tail.
